description: Ranked cross-signal feed of CoinBucha's leading, non-price Bitcoin indicators. Returns { as_of, btc_price_usd, count, signals[], disclaimer, attribution, source_terms }, where each signal carries id, type, title, value, unit, signal_strength (0-100), direction (tailwind | headwind | neutral), a one-line why, sources[] and its own as_of. Optional filters narrow by strength, direction or signal type. Example: {"min_strength": 70, "direction": "tailwind"} — call with {} for the full ranked list. CoinGecko values carry attribution: "Powered by CoinGecko" and source_terms. Observational data; information, not financial advice.
